title: The Best Castles for Kids: UK Castle Days Out
description: The best castles to visit with kids and teens in the UK: Warwick, Edinburgh, Dover, Caernarfon, Alnwick and the Tower of London, with saving tips.
intro: Towers to climb, dungeons to dare and battlements to defend. Castles are where history becomes an adventure.

image.alt: A stone castle under white clouds

cardText: Warwick, Dover, Edinburgh, Caernarfon and more.

blocks.title: Scout’s castle tip
blocks.text: Check the events calendar for jousts, archery and costumed storytellers. Event days make a castle visit unforgettable.

sections.html:
• Warwick Castle: shows, towers and family events (on the Merlin pass).
  • Dover Castle: medieval keep plus secret wartime tunnels (English Heritage).
  • Tower of London: Crown Jewels and Yeoman Warders.
  • Alnwick Castle: Harry Potter’s Hogwarts and broomstick training.

• Edinburgh Castle: on its volcanic rock above the city.
  • Caernarfon Castle: a mighty fortress cared for by Cadw.
Compare heritage memberships, and see all castles and history days out.

faqs.a: Dover Castle in Kent has tunnels used during the Second World War, which visitors can explore.
